test_name: Validate Navigation to Privacy Policy from Login Page
description: This test ensures that users can navigate to the Privacy Policy page from the login page and verify its content.
steps: Locate and click the 'Privacy Policy' link in the footer.
Verify redirection to the Privacy Policy page (https://roost.ai/privacy-policy).
Check that the Privacy Policy content is displayed correctly.
Verify the 'Privacy Policy' page is accessible and responsive.
Return to the login page using the browser's back button.
Confirm the login page is displayed correctly after navigation.
expected_results: User is redirected to the Privacy Policy page.
Privacy Policy content is displayed accurately.
Login page is displayed correctly when the user navigates back.
edge_cases: Privacy Policy page fails to load.
Broken link to the Privacy Policy page.
Privacy Policy content is outdated or incorrect.
Navigation back to the login page fails.
data_requirements: Valid URL for the Privacy Policy page.
Correct content on the Privacy Policy page.
Accessible footer link on the login page.
dependencies: Privacy Policy page is hosted and operational.
Footer links are visible and clickable.
Login page is fully loaded before navigation.
No ad-blockers or extensions interfere with navigation.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load the Privacy Policy page.
Responsiveness of the Privacy Policy page.
Time taken to return to the login page.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the 'Privacy Policy' link has an appropriate ARIA label.
Verify the Privacy Policy page is navigable via keyboard.
Check for screen reader compatibility on the Privacy Policy page.
Ensure high contrast for all text on the Privacy Policy page.
Verify proper focus management after returning to the login page.
